title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
text: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation Close A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after the former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through. No casualties were reported after the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine. All the passengers had been evacuated, Ukrainian authorities said. Johnson and other European national security advisers, including the UK's Jonathan Powell, had passed along the same line on a different train on their way back from a conference in Kyiv. BBC's James Landale explains why the incident could signal an escalation in Russia's war against Ukraine. More on this story here. title: A woman in a Russian border city rejected a uniformed man’s advances. Two days later, she says, masked soldiers abducted her and demanded she confess to Ukraine ties.
text: news A woman in a Russian border city rejected a uniformed man’s advances. Two days later, she says, masked soldiers abducted her and demanded she confess to Ukraine ties. September 14, 2026, 12:43 am Source: Vot Tak A woman living in a major Russian border city says men in military uniforms abducted her, threatened to torture her with electric shocks, searched her phone, and demanded that she acknowledge possible ties to Ukraine. Two days earlier, she had rebuffed a serviceman who approached her in a parking lot. The woman, Angelina, told the news outlet Vot Tak about the ordeal. She believes the two incidents are connected, though reporters could not independently verify a link. Angelina said she stopped in a store parking lot on her way home on September 8. At her request, the outlet did not identify the city. A man in a military uniform who was sitting in a nearby car called her over. He appeared to be about 50. His uniform had no shoulder insignia, but it bore a patch that Angelina could not make out. title: Politics live: Hastie urges deal with US to get AI model; Taylor says Hanson’s comments on Albanese’s mother ‘off limits’
text: 20.28 EDT Hastie says Australia will be ‘supplicant state’ without US AI deal Luca Ittimani Andrew Hastie has claimed Australia will become a “supplicant state” if it doesn’t make a deal with the US to get its frontier AI, suggesting the Aukus military agreement could be a suitable path. The shadow industry minister told the Sydney Dialogue the US government’s shutdown of access to Claude Mythos in June showed Australia could be held hostage if it didn’t get local AI capacity. He said: Without a sovereign AI frontier model here in Australia, we are going to be a supplicant state, not a sovereign state … People think it’s making memes on ChatGPT. We’re talking about the global order being changed and Australia falling behind. Hastie said Australia was far behind in the race for development so should look to make a deal with the US as it makes its AI “arms race” against China. We need to work on a way to get a hyperscaler down under, or multiple hyperscalers to invest in sovereign capability, the same way Ford and General Motors did 100 years ago … I think working with the United States, through Aukus if we want to use that frame, is the pathway. Gaudron was appointed to the high court in 1987, aged 44, and served until 2003. Her death was confirmed in multiple tributes posted online on Sunday. text: ⠀ 🔴 Интервью на фронте с добровольцами - участниками СВО. Наш Центр истории СВО (директор - М. С. Григорьев) продолжает сбор воспоминаний участников специальной военной операции в рамках проекта "Хранить вечно". Смотреть на Rutube Смотреть предыдущее интервью Доброволец с позывным "Кеку", добровольческий отряд БАРС-23 "Орёл": 00:00 "Сейчас у меня второй контракт. До этого боевого опыта не было. Работал в строительстве, потом на заводе, а потом ушёл сюда. 01:18 Когда решил идти добровольцем, супруга не хотела меня отпускать, но знала мой характер — если я что-то решил, то обязательно сделаю. В итоге приняла это решение, хотя, конечно, переживала. У меня двое детей — дочери 13 лет и сыну 8. 01:52 С самого начала специальной военной операции я собирался идти, но были семейные трудности. Всё это время мысль не уходила. Здесь служит много моих друзей и знакомых. По душе было идти сюда. 02:46 Запомнились боевые выходы в лесополосы. Сидишь в блиндаже, над тобой висит дрон, рядом идут сбросы, адреналин очень сильно чувствуется. 03:45 Страх есть у каждого человека. Не боится только дурак. Главно ему не поддаваться.
